data.one_liner: Displays an About dialog which describes the application, shows licenses, and changelogs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable about page or dialog for Flutter applications. It can display application descriptions, icons, legalese, markdown changelogs, and license information.
use_when: You need to quickly add an About dialog or page to your Flutter application.
You want to display app licenses and a changelog parsed from markdown.
avoid_when: You are building a command-line or headless Dart application.
You want an completely custom drawer or settings menu unrelated to app details.
strengths: Supports displaying licenses and changelogs easily.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Allows custom templates and markdown files.
weaknesses: Relies on specific file naming and assets like CHANGELOG.md for certain list tiles.
